reason: My order book is full for months, so a missed call doesn't cost me anything. Whoever really needs us calls back or messages me on WhatsApp anyway, and I'm not paying 99 euros a month to collect even more requests I can't take on.
objection: My customers want to talk to a person, not get an automatic text from a two-founder startup with no customers. If a regular gets a robot message, that looks worse than me calling back in the evening.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 14-day check showed regular customers or emergencies were actually getting lost, and the ausgebucht mode really kept everything else off my phone, I might try it.
